## Purpose
The Knowledge page API: build guidance and reference items, their sources (file, URL or text, extracted and then distilled into items by an LLM), a retrieval preview, feedback statistics and embeddings. It also serves the Processes page's recommendation import.

## Responsibilities
| Endpoint | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `GET /knowledge/items?kind&status&category&concept_id&source_id&limit≤10000` | `{items, count}` |
| `POST /knowledge/items` | `ItemBody{kind="guidance", category, concept_id, title, body, tags, audience, subject="both", strength, conditions, effect, layers, rationale, status="active", confidence, as_of}` saved with `origin: "user"` |
| `GET/PUT/DELETE /knowledge/items/{id}` | read, edit or delete; 404 "Knowledge item not found." |
| `POST /knowledge/items/status` | body `{ids, status}`; returns `{updated}` |
| `GET /knowledge/counts` | `{counts, sources}` |
| `GET /knowledge/vocabulary` | kinds, reference and guidance categories, strengths, audiences, subjects, statuses, `category_views`, `default_mode`, `auto_approve`, plus `distill.describe_vocabulary()` |
| `GET /knowledge/sources` | every source |
| `POST /knowledge/sources` | multipart: file or url or text, plus title, concept_id, library_id, auto_approve; calls `ingest.add_source(...)` |
| `POST /knowledge/sources/{id}/distill` | distil again, replacing its proposed items |
| `DELETE /knowledge/sources/{id}?items=true` | delete the source, with its items unless `items=false` |
| `POST /knowledge/retrieve` | body `{goal, concept_ids, facts, subject, include_proposed}`; see Key elements |
| `GET /knowledge/feedback` | guidance that builds used, sorted by rolled-back builds then uses; returns the items and `rollback_threshold = store.UNHELPFUL_ROLLBACKS` |
| `POST /knowledge/embed` | `{embedded: embed.embed_missing(client)}` |
| `POST /processes/recommendations/import` | file or `content`, plus domain_id and save (default true); calls `recommendations.import_recommendations(...)`; with `save` the `document` is removed from each entry |
| `POST /processes/recommendations/missing` | `{missing, required: [{path, why}]}` |

## Key elements
- **`/knowledge/retrieve`** returns exactly what a build would receive:
  1. Candidates are active guidance (plus proposed items when asked) for the builder or both audiences, with their embeddings.
  2. The goal is embedded only when some candidate has a vector.
  3. `retrieval.select(...)` runs with `limit=GUIDANCE_PACK_SIZE` and `view_min`.
  4. `build_pack(mode="preview")`.
  5. Returns `{items, views, rendered: {view: render(pack, view, limit=GUIDANCE_VIEW_SIZE)}, embedding_used}`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
- The knowledge tables (`app/knowledge/store.py`).
- Mistral OCR, distillation and embedding calls during ingest and embedding.
- The process recommendation tables.

## Configuration
`KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE_MAX_MB` (a larger file gets 413), `GUIDANCE_PACK_SIZE`, `GUIDANCE_VIEW_SIZE`, `GUIDANCE_DEFAULT_MODE` and `GUIDANCE_AUTO_APPROVE`.

## Interactions
- Route policy:
  - retrieve and GET need knowledge.view;
  - writes need knowledge.manage;
  - the processes recommendations routes need knowledge.manage.
- Builds read guidance through `app/knowledge/pipeline.py`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- `KnowledgeError` and `ImportError_` become 400.
- Sending neither a file nor content to the import gets 400 "Send a file or the JSON content."

## Nuances and gotchas
`PUT /knowledge/items/{id}` takes a raw dict, not a model; the store validates it.

The handlers and models in the table.
